text: I've been waiting nearly an hour so I'll just write it down. Granddaughter, 4, temp 37.8 I think, the thermometer's a bit old. She won't settle tonight, keeps getting up, but otherwise she seems her normal self, playing about. Weeing normally. I nearly had a fit myself when I saw purple marks all over her legs, but it was felt-tip, she'd been colouring on herself, it came straight off in the bath. Not sure if I'm worrying over nothing, probably am, but I'd like someone to tell me.
